text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hello, Sweep-san. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So you think it looks bad, huh? Maybe 
you should go wash your face and look 
again!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you're your usual self. 
That smile is so cute it's almost 
infuriating.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Still, once the race is over, you might 
just end up crying because of me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha ha! You say some pretty funny 
things!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm definitely, positively not 
gonna cry for you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll win this race, stand at the very top 
above you all—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna laugh right in their faces, with 
everything I've got!!

The final race of the Triple Tiara route, 
the Shuka Sho. The final battle to 
determine the representative of this 
generation begins now!
